blocks.text: Molecular & Empirical Formulae of Organic Compounds

blocks.md:
- The **molecular formula **shows the number and type of each atom in a molecule

  - E.g. the molecular formula of ethanoic acid is C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>4</sub>O<sub>2</sub>
- The **empirical formula** shows the simplest whole number ratio of the elements present in one molecule of the compound

  - E.g. the empirical formula of ethanol is CH<sub>2</sub>O
